1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for p-phenylenediamine for cosmetic industry.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this standard, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards:
